title: Advanced pricing rules
intro: Optional: to add or replace a specific line of quotes. Each line of a quote comes from a rule. For one component, only one rule applies: the highest priority, then the most specific, then the latest. Changing a rule creates a new version; quotes already sent keep theirs.
empty: No rules yet. Without rules, a quote is the product, the carrier's quote and the TraceCart fee.
caption: Pricing rules

settings.title: Prices and margins
settings.subtitle: Set the steps in order: each one is used by the next. Once the required steps are done, the shop gives a delivered price for every product it finds.

margins.title: Margins — {hub}
margins.intro: How TraceCart earns on orders from this hub, in {currency}. All of it stays inside the customer's single delivered price. A fee set by hand on an order replaces the tiers.
margins.tiers: Fee on the product, by value
margins.tiersHint: Each tier covers products up to its value in {currency}; leave the last without a limit.
margins.markupHint: Added on top of the carrier's price.
margins.bufferHint: Of the product price: absorbs supplier price changes and weight differences, so staff can buy without going back to the customer.
margins.noTiers: No tiers: TraceCart takes {percent}% of the value of every product.
margins.minHint: TraceCart never takes less on an order. Empty or 0: no minimum.

errors.oneOpen: Only one tier can have no limit: give the others a maximum value.
errors.sameLimit: Two tiers have the same limit: change one of them.

example.title: Example to check your figures (not saved)
example.total: Price the customer pays, before customs
example.note: TraceCart earns {earned}, plus the buffer ({buffer}) when it isn't used.

fx.title: Exchange rates
fx.intro: Used to convert a carrier's quote, a rule or customs figures in another currency, and supplier prices. A rate converts both ways. There's no live feed: keep them current.
fx.missing: Rates still needed to give a price:

customs.title: Customs rates
customs.intro: Duties and taxes estimated by destination and product category (or any category), as a percentage of the goods and transport, plus the broker fee. Passed on at cost and shown apart.

categories.title: Weight by category
categories.intro: Packed weight and size per unit assumed for a product of this category when it has none of its own, so it can be priced. The hub weighs the goods before the carrier leg.

form.amountHint: Per calculation unit (per package, per kg…).
form.rateHint: As a percentage of the value chosen under “Calculation”.
form.currencyHint: Of the amount, minimum and maximum.
form.priorityHint: For the same item, the highest wins (0 by default).
form.rateSourceHint: Contract, carrier quote… The date is recorded.
form.descriptionHint: For the team, never shown to the customer.

setup.title: Getting started
setup.intro: What the shop needs to give a customer a price: the required steps first, in order.

search.title: Product search
search.hint: Products are found live by Mindcase (Amazon, Google Maps); Claude reads descriptions and photos.

hub.title: Your hub
hub.hint: The hub orders leave from, and its currency: every price is given in it.

routes.title: Carrier routes and rates
routes.hint: At least one active route with its rates (fee per shipment, price per kg) to a delivery country. Without a route, no product has a price.

exchangeRates.title: Exchange rates
exchangeRates.hint: Products are bought in USD or EUR (Amazon): they need a rate to the hub's currency.

margins.title: Margins
margins.hint: What TraceCart earns on each order. Unset, only the default percentage applies.

customs.title: Customs rates
customs.hint: Duties and taxes by delivery country. Without them, prices are given before customs.

detail.routes: {count, plural, one {# route} other {# routes}} with rates to {countries}
detail.routesWithoutRates: {count, plural, one {# route has} other {# routes have}} no rates yet: add them to give a price.
